_comment: Identities that are never allowed as commit author or in a Signed-off-by trailer under a profile with dco.forbid_agent_identity. Patterns are case-insensitive shell globs. Keep name patterns narrow: 'Claude' is also a human given name, so match the full agent names, not substrings. A literal '[' must be written as '[[]' because '[...]' is a character class in a glob.
